question_cn: L 组头名（小组赛最终积分榜第一）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group L?
one_liner_cn: 英格兰 Elo 领先克罗地亚 112 分且名单齐整，6/17 揭幕战直接对话定走向，约七成概率拿下 L 组头名；莫德里奇术后状态存疑令克罗地亚小幅下调。
one_liner_en: England lead Croatia by 112 Elo points with a full-strength squad, and the June 17 head-to-head opener decides the group — roughly a 70% chance to finish first; Modric's post-surgery fitness doubt slightly downgrades Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距明确：英格兰 2024（世界第 4）领先克罗地亚 1912（#12）112 分，巴拿马 1730、加纳 1510 差距悬殊；10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中英格兰 68.4% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: England 2024 (world #4) lead Croatia 1912 (#12) by 112 points, with Panama 1730 and Ghana 1510 far behind; England top the group in 68.4% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 英格兰无人员危机：图赫尔 5/22 公布 26 人名单，凯恩任队长、贝林厄姆在列，无重大伤停。
key_reasons.en: No England availability crisis: Tuchel named the 26-man squad on May 22 with Kane as captain and Bellingham included; no major absences.

key_reasons.cn: 唯一挑战者带伤疑：克罗地亚 40 岁队长莫德里奇 4 月颧骨骨折手术、缺席俱乐部赛季收官，预计赶上 6/17 对英格兰的首战但状态存疑（调整 −1.5pp）。
key_reasons.en: The only challenger carries a fitness doubt: Croatia's 40-year-old captain Modric had cheekbone-fracture surgery in April and missed the end of the club season; he is expected fit for the June 17 opener vs England, but sharpness is uncertain (−1.5pp adjustment).

method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Croatia -1.5pp for Modric's post-surgery fitness doubt (in squad, expected fit for the opener), renormalized to sum 1; all deltas within +/-4pp. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data used.
